objective: Second review found remaining Phase 05 blockers. Apply all fixes; preserve Phase 04/unrelated changes and do not change plan docs. Environment Windows 11, CWD G:/ws/sharing/dam-hopper. Requirements: (1) NEVER retry create/update/delete/start/stop/restart/listKeys/approve/purge after MANAGER_SESSION_MISMATCH. Only snapshot may one-time reopen client + reactivate active scope; mutations return parsed mismatch after recovery/snapshot so UI requires retry. (2) One owner for hint reconciliation: eliminate adapter+hook duplicate snapshot. Implement one-in-flight plus one trailing refresh with strict BigInt freshness and ensure consumers can receive accepted refreshed state without issuing a second snapshot. (3) strict-parse snapshot/key inventory/activation/open response DTOs, including counters, timestamp/profile/runtime/challenge/key fields; reject malformed as fixed IPC_UNAVAILABLE. (4) Include all Phase 03 Rust compatibility error codes in shared union/parser parity. (5) Add required focused tests: adapter A/B/C late response, no mutation replay manager recovery, wrong/reordered/duplicate hint bounded refresh; context deletion waits activation/replacement then purge and unavailable read doesn’t purge; hook behavior; server-config typed events/read failure. Fix tests/lint. Run focused tests (not accidental full suite), native/ui build, lint, diff check. Concise final report with exact changed files/commands/results/residual risks/unresolved questions last.
